title: Roof snow load.
officialText:
The ground snow load, P , shall be indicated. The following additional information shall also be
g
provided, regardless of whether snow loads govern the design of the roof:
1. Flat-roof snow load, P f.
2. Snow exposure factor, C .
e
3. Snow load importance factor, I .
s
4. Thermal factor, C .
t
